protocol: Four 300-second learning windows including startup/probes; endpoint normal and lesson evaluation capped at 420 seconds per run. No final-test cases.
limitations: Both learner seeds start from one mastered saving model.
Development validation; two short transfer continuations, not independent full curricula.
CI resamples paired game seeds within each fixed learner run; it is not across-run uncertainty.
Desktop and thermal load uncontrolled; throughput is descriptive.
